items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: we had two other records--Ruth Lee on one record

ctx.x: His name was Andrae? Is that right?

Andrae Nordskog. And I don't know where he got this little old thing he had but it'd break down every minute, you know, and it was rough, iron (?) and that, but I heard about him, and I went out there and we decided to make these records, and it was a tryout for him, and it was a tryout for me, and I made these records, and he put his name on them, and I had to go have labels made and paste over the name. And...and that was all we made out there was that one record by Kid Ory. And 'course, we had two other…
